text: Illustrate the story here: Cubs in the Den Mom sees the cubs. Mom and the cubs get in the den. The den is big. Mom sits in the den. The cubs see bugs and bats in the den. The cubs get the bugs. The cubs do not get the bats. Mom and the cubs nap in the den.
